description: This file defines the OAuthService class in the OrangeHRM project, which manages OAuth client configurations related to mobile application access, including enabling/disabling the client and retrieving client details.

classes.name: OAuthService
classes.description: Provides methods to manage OAuth clients, specifically for handling mobile client status and retrieval within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDao
methods.description: Returns the OAuthClientDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: updateMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the mobile OAuth client based on the provided boolean.

methods.name: getMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the mobile OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: getMobileClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the mobile OAuth client, or null if not found.
